eq-ch03-band-prop: Layer optical depth from extinction and thickness; single-scattering albedo kept below 1 by a margin.
eq-ch03-band-flux: pyharp's two flux channels from cdisort's upward diffuse, downward diffuse and direct fluxes.
eq-ch03-ordinates-kernel: Azimuth-averaged scattering kernel from the first 2N Legendre moments (Stamnes et al. 1988, eq. 6b, m = 0).
eq-ch03-ordinates-do: Discrete-ordinate equations: the scattering integral replaced by the double-Gauss sum (eq. 7a).
eq-ch03-ordinates-eigen: Order reduction of the 2N x 2N eigenproblem to an N x N one for the squared eigenvalues (eqs. 8c-8e).
eq-ch03-ordinates-beam: Linear system for the beam particular solution Z0 exp(-tau/mu0) (eq. 9a).
eq-ch03-ordinates-thermal: Linear systems for the particular solution Y0 + Y1 tau of a Planck source linear in tau (eq. 9c).
eq-ch03-ordinates-surface: Lambertian bottom boundary condition with emissivity 1 - albedo, azimuthal mode 0 (eqs. 12, 17d).
eq-ch03-ordinates-scaled: Homogeneous solution with scaled constants, so that every exponential is at most 1 (eqs. 22-23).
eq-ch03-ordinates-fluxes: Diffuse fluxes as quadrature sums of the intensities; direct flux in closed form.
eq-ch03-deltam-moments: Delta-M moments chi*_l = (chi_l - f)/(1 - f) with f = chi_2N (Wiscombe 1977, eqs. 14-15).
eq-ch03-deltam-scale: Delta-M scaled optical depth and single-scattering albedo (Wiscombe 1977, eqs. 20a-20b).
eq-ch03-intcorr-single: Singly scattered intensity of one layer for a downward direction (Nakajima and Tanaka 1988, eq. 12).
eq-ch03-intcorr-tms: TMS correction: delta-M single scattering replaced by the exact one (Nakajima and Tanaka 1988, eq. 15).
eq-ch03-intcorr-ims: IMS secondary-scattering correction in the aureole (Nakajima and Tanaka 1988, eq. 23).
eq-ch03-intcorr-h: Closed form of the IMS geometry factor h (Nakajima and Tanaka 1988, eq. 24).
